title: Set 125

sentences.ko: 동생이 금요일에 우리 집에 올라왔다가 일요일 밤까지 있었어. 그렇게 있을 줄은 나도 몰랐고. 그래서 주말 대부분을 둘이 차 타고 돌아다니면서 동생이 사지도 않을 트럭들을 구경했어. 그게 싫었던 건 아니야. 그냥 미리 말이라도 해 줬으면 좋았겠다 싶었지. 그러고 동생이 가고 나서 부엌을 봤는데, 아 그래, 내 일요일은 이렇게 갔구나 싶었어.
sentences.text: My brother came up Friday and ended up staying till Sunday night, which I didn't know was the plan, so most of the weekend was the two of us driving around looking at trucks he's not going to buy. I don't mind it, I just would've liked a heads up. And then he left and I looked at the kitchen and thought, okay, so that was my Sunday.

alts.text: So my brother turns up Friday and just stays till Sunday night, which nobody told me was happening, so most of the weekend was us driving around looking at trucks he's not gonna buy. I don't mind it, I just would've liked a heads up. Then he left and I looked at the kitchen and went, okay, so that was my Sunday.

My brother arrived on Friday and remained until Sunday evening, which I had not been told was the plan, so most of the weekend was the two of us driving around looking at trucks he does not intend to buy. I do not mind it, I simply would have appreciated some advance notice. Then he left, and I looked at the kitchen and thought, well, that was my Sunday.

sentences.note: **ended up staying** 은 그럴 계획이 없었는데 결국 그렇게 됐다는 뜻이에요. **a heads up** 은 미리 알려 주는 것을 말해요.

sentences.ko: 우리 고양이가 새벽 다섯 시에 서랍장에서 뭘 떨어뜨리면 내가 일어난다는 걸 알아냈어. 그래서 이제 하루도 안 빼고 아침마다 그래. 나는 자기 전에 다 바닥에 내려놓기 시작했는데, 남편은 그건 고양이가 나를 훈련시키는 거지 그 반대가 아니라고 하더라. 맞는 말이야. 그래도 새벽 다섯 시에 컵이 바닥에 떨어지는 소리를 듣느니 컵을 옮겨 놓는 게 나아.
sentences.text: Our cat figured out that if she knocks something off the dresser at five in the morning, I'll get up, so now she does it every single morning. I've started putting everything on the floor before bed, and my husband says that's her training me, not the other way around. He's right, but I'd still rather move a glass than hear it hit the floor at five.

alts.text: So our cat's figured out that if she shoves something off the dresser at five, I'll get up, so now that's every morning. I've started putting everything on the floor before bed, and my husband says she's training me, not the other way around. He's right, but I'd rather move a glass than hear it hit the floor at five.

Our cat has determined that if she knocks something off the dresser at five in the morning, I will get up, so she now does it every single morning. I have begun placing everything on the floor before bed, and my husband says that she is training me, not the other way around. He is correct, but I would still rather move a glass than hear it hit the floor at five.

sentences.note: **figured out** 은 이리저리 해 보다가 알아냈다는 뜻이에요. **the other way around** 은 상황이 그 반대라는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 내가 소개해 주고 싶은 사람은 사촌 룸메이트야. 미리 말해 두는데 처음 삼십 분쯤은 말이 거의 없어. 그러니까 얘기를 제대로 해 보기 전에 아니라고 단정하지는 마. 편해지면 진짜 웃겨. 봄에 전 애인이랑 헤어지고 나서 쭉 혼자였는데, 본인은 이제 괜찮다고 하니까 나는 그 말을 그대로 믿는 거야. 목요일에 시간 돼?
sentences.text: So the guy I want you to meet is my cousin's roommate, and I'll tell you up front that he's quiet for about the first half hour, so don't write him off before you've actually talked to him. Once he's comfortable he's really funny. He's been on his own since he and his ex split up in the spring, and he says he's ready, so I'm taking him at his word. Are you free Thursday?

alts.text: Okay, so he's my cousin's roommate, and I'll just tell you now, he's quiet for like the first half hour, so don't write him off before you've actually talked to him. Once he's comfortable he's really funny. He's been on his own since he and his ex split up in the spring, and he says he's ready, so I'm taking his word for it. You free Thursday?

The man I would like you to meet is my cousin's roommate, and I should tell you at the outset that he is quiet for roughly the first half hour, so please do not dismiss him before you have actually spoken with him. Once he is comfortable, he is genuinely funny. He has been on his own since he and his former partner separated in the spring, and he says he is ready, so I am taking him at his word. Are you available Thursday?

sentences.note: **write him off** 는 가능성 없다고 미리 제쳐 두는 것이고, **taking him at his word** 는 그 사람 말을 그대로 믿어 준다는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 친구 소개팅 주선하면서 상대가 어떤 사람인지 설명하기

sentences.ko: 아무 말도 하지 마, 나도 알아. 알람을 일곱 시로 맞췄는데 저녁 일곱 시로 맞췄더라고. 살면서 딱 한 번 그런 적이 있었는데 그날도 월요일이었어. 그래서 한 4분 만에 일어나서 집을 나왔어. 내 꼴만 봐도 아마 알겠지. 잠깐만 기다려 줘, 바로 갈게.
sentences.text: Don't even say it, I know. I set my alarm for seven, except I set it for seven at night, and I've done that exactly once before in my life and it was also a Monday. So I was up and out the door in about four minutes, which you can probably tell just by looking at me. Give me one second and I'll be right with you.

alts.text: Don't. I know. I set my alarm for seven, except it was seven at night, and I've done that exactly once before in my life and that was a Monday too. I was up and out the door in like four minutes, which you can probably tell just by looking at me. Gimme one sec and I'll be right with you.

Please do not say it, I am aware. I set my alarm for seven, except that I set it for seven in the evening, and I have done that exactly once before in my life, and it was also a Monday. So I was up and out the door in about four minutes, which you can likely tell simply by looking at me. Give me one moment and I will be right with you.

sentences.note: **out the door** 는 집을 나섰다는 말이고, **I'll be right with you** 는 잠깐만 있으면 바로 준비된다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.ko: 나 이것만 먹고 가 볼게. 베이비시터한테 열 시라고 했는데 벌써 아홉 시 십오 분이고, 그 애는 아침에 수업이 있어. 아니야, 일어나지 마. 밥 다 먹어. 나는 재킷만 챙기면 돼. 그리고 다음번엔 우리 집에서 하자. 그러면 내가 빠져나갈 데가 없을 테니까.
sentences.text: Hey, I'm going to head out after this, because we told the sitter ten and it's already quarter after nine, and she's got class in the morning. No, don't get up, finish your food, I'll just grab my jacket. And next time we're doing this at our place, so I won't have anywhere to run off to.

alts.text: Yeah, I'm gonna take off after this, because we told the sitter ten and it's already quarter after nine, and she's got class in the morning. No, don't get up, finish your food, I'll just grab my jacket. And next time we're doing this at our place, so I won't have anywhere to run off to.

Excuse me, I am going to leave after this, because we told the sitter ten and it is already quarter past nine, and she has class in the morning. No, please do not get up, finish your food, I will simply collect my jacket. And next time we will do this at our home, so I will not have anywhere to run off to.

sentences.note: **head out** 은 자리에서 일어나 간다는 말이고, **quarter after nine** 은 아홉 시 십오 분이에요. **run off to** 는 급히 빠져나가는 것을 말해요.
sentences.situation: 저녁 모임에서 먼저 일어날 구실 만들기

reviewed: 4번의 I'm with you 는 보통 "네 말에 동의해" 로 읽혀서 기다려 달라는 뜻으로는 헷갈립니다. I'll be right with you 로 고치고 note 도 그에 맞췄습니다.
4번 한국어에 about(한 4분쯤)의 어림수가 빠져 있어 영어와 맞췄습니다.
1번 캐주얼이 본문과 똑같은 말로 시작해서(My brother ... Friday) 말투 차이가 안 보였습니다. 현재형 이야기체로 앞부분을 다시 썼습니다.
2번 캐주얼의 worked out 은 미국 구어에서 잘 안 쓰는 말이고 시작도 본문과 겹쳐서, 줄임말로 더 짧게 썼습니다.
3번 캐주얼이 본문 첫 열몇 낱말을 그대로 반복해서 앞부분을 다시 썼습니다.
4번·5번 캐주얼도 본문과 같은 말로 시작해서 앞머리를 바꿨습니다.
5번 격식체의 we shall 은 지나치게 과해서 we will 로 낮췄습니다. 뜻은 그대로입니다.
1번 한국어 마지막 줄이 "이걸로 끝이구나" 라 영어(그렇게 주말이 다 갔다)와 미묘하게 달라 고쳤습니다.
